cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Let's secure the date, then count chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the quote while you say yes. That way we won't lose the booking while you're reading it.

mechanism: A leads party booking by appearing responsive to guest and cost concerns while trying to obtain approval before those concerns can be checked.
confusable: Unlike ordinary consultation, A offers later control only in exchange for an immediate yes; confidence must bend around B objections.
comparison: A committee chair trades guest-list and budget control for immediate booking; the sofa alternative bargains over physical measuring.
seedUse: Use canonical D28-a booking deadline and deferred quote, plus S02-a adopting others priorities as a leadership decision.
